server.description: FTP server hostname or IP address to upload files to.

port.description: FTP server port. Standard FTP uses 21. Use 22 only if your server supports SFTP (wput does not support SFTP natively — use only FTP/FTPS).

user.description: Username for FTP authentication. If empty, wput will prompt interactively.

password.description: Password for FTP authentication. For security, prefer interactive entry or keyring; never commit secrets to config in production.

remote_dir.description: Absolute path of the remote directory where files will be uploaded by default.

connect_timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds before aborting FTP connection.

passive.description: Enable passive mode FTP. Required in most NAT/firewall environments.

verbosity.description: Verbosity level: 0 (quiet), 1 (normal), 2 (debug). Can be overridden with -v on command line.

resume.description: If true, resume partial uploads instead of restarting. Useful for large files over unreliable links.

skip_existing.description: If true, skip uploading files that already exist on the server (based on size/modified time).

ftps.description: Enable FTPS (explicit FTP over TLS). Note: wput’s TLS support is optional and depends on compile-time options. Not supported by all builds.

exclude_patterns.description: List of glob patterns or filenames to exclude from upload (e.g., '*.tmp', '.git/*').

items.description: A shell-style glob pattern or literal filename to exclude.

extra_args.description: List of additional wput CLI arguments to apply to every invocation (e.g., ['--retry=3', '--reconnect=5']).

items.description: A single wput command-line option (without the leading '--'). wput will prepend '--' automatically when parsing this list.
